search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Used the allotted focused research turns. The available evidence does not resolve the period or denominator for the approximately 72% customer-share claim.
The largest-customer statement is supported only by a secondary report without a disclosed period or underlying customer-level data.
The official prospectus gives Bosch Group shares of consolidated net sales for 2017 and 2018, not an approximately 72% share for an identified period.
